Severity scan on pair0: jpeg:2=31.10dB, jpeg:3=28.52, jpeg:4=27.23, jpeg:5=24.48 — sev 1 is the unique exact answer (gap infinite). Blur ruled out (spectral_slope_ratio ~1.0), global ruled out (variance_ratio ~0.99, mean_shift <=0.3/255), noise ruled out (peeled residual after jpeg:1 is exactly zero; pair4's raw sigma=4.57 was JPEG-artifact contamination).
